home.title: Fashion Palette
home.welcome: Discover your perfect color palette based on your unique features. Fashion Palette uses advanced color analysis to help you look your best and make confident fashion choices that truly complement your natural coloring.
home.uploadPhotoDesc: Take a clear photo in natural lighting or upload an existing one.
home.getAnalysisDesc: Our AI analyzes your photo and determines your seasonal color palette.
home.tryColorsDesc: Visualize how different colors look on you with our virtual try-on feature.
home.shopConfidenceDesc: Use your personalized color recommendations for shopping.

winter.name: Winter
winter.desc: Winter colors are cool, bold, and high-contrast, often suiting people with striking features like dark hair and pale skin or deep skin tones with cool undertones.

spring.name: Spring
spring.desc: Spring colors are warm, fresh, and vibrant, perfect for people with light, warm-toned skin, golden hair, and bright eyes.

summer.name: Summer
summer.desc: Summer colors are soft, cool, and muted, ideal for those with light, cool-toned skin, ash-blonde or light brown hair, and soft eye colors.

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.desc: Autumn colors are warm, rich, and earthy, complementing people with warm-toned skin, red or golden-brown hair, and deep, warm eyes.

twelveSeasons.name: 12 Seasons Analysis
twelveSeasons.desc: Discover your precise seasonal palette with our advanced 12-season analysis.

makeup.name: Makeup Simulation
makeup.desc: Try on makeup in your recommended colors virtually.

wardrobe.name: Wardrobe Management
wardrobe.desc: Build and manage a wardrobe with your best colors.

confidence.name: Color Confidence Score
confidence.desc: Get a confidence score for how well colors suit you.

upload.title: Upload Your Photo
upload.subtitle: Take or upload a clear photo in natural lighting for the best results
upload.tip4: Wear a neutral color (white, black, or gray)

welcome.title: Welcome to Fashion Palette!
welcome.text: This quick tutorial will show you how to use the color visualization features to find your perfect colors.

overlay.title: Try Scarf Overlay
overlay.text: Click on the scarf overlay button to see how colors would look as a scarf around your neck.

compare.title: Compare Colors
compare.text: Use the split-screen view to compare two different colors side by side and see which one suits you better.

favorites.title: Save Your Favorites
favorites.text: Click the star icon to save colors you love to your favorites collection for future reference.
